name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) - Public Distribution System

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministry.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution

overview: A legal entitlement scheme providing subsidised foodgrains to about two-thirds of India's population through the Targeted Public Distribution System.
objectives: Ensure food and nutritional security for the population
Provide subsidised foodgrains through fair price shops
Cover priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana families

benefits.title: Subsidised Foodgrains
benefits.description: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month at subsidised rates for priority households

otherCriteria: Households identified as Priority Households or AAY by state governments

applicationProcess.description: Apply for a ration card through the state food & civil supplies department
Get included in Priority Household/AAY list
Collect subsidised foodgrains from fair price shop monthly

faqs.question: Who is covered under NFSA?
faqs.answer: Up to 75% of rural and 50% of urban population as per state-wise coverage.

faqs.question: What is provided under NFSA?
faqs.answer: Subsidised rice, wheat and coarse grains through fair price shops.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministry.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution

overview: A scheme providing free additional foodgrains to NFSA beneficiaries, integrated with NFSA entitlements to ensure food security for the poor and vulnerable.
objectives: Ensure no beneficiary family goes hungry
Provide free foodgrains over and above NFSA entitlement
Support vulnerable sections during economic distress

benefits.title: Free Foodgrains
benefits.description: Additional free foodgrains provided monthly to NFSA beneficiary households

otherCriteria: NFSA beneficiary households (Priority Households and AAY families)

applicationProcess.description: Ensure inclusion in NFSA beneficiary list
Collect free foodgrains from designated fair price shop

faqs.question: Is PMGKAY separate from NFSA?
faqs.answer: It supplements NFSA entitlements and is now merged with regular NFSA allocation.

faqs.question: Who benefits?
faqs.answer: All NFSA-covered Priority Household and Antyodaya Anna Yojana families.

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministry.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution

overview: A scheme under NFSA providing highly subsidised foodgrains to the poorest of the poor households identified by state governments.
objectives: Provide food security to the poorest of the poor households
Identify and cover the most vulnerable families

benefits.title: Highly Subsidised Foodgrains
benefits.description: 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month at nominal rates

otherCriteria: Poorest of poor households identified by state governments as per AAY criteria

applicationProcess.description: Get identified as poorest of poor by state government survey
Collect monthly foodgrain quota from fair price shop

faqs.question: Who identifies AAY households?
faqs.answer: State/UT governments based on prescribed criteria.

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministry.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution

overview: A scheme enabling NFSA beneficiaries, especially migrant workers, to access their food subsidy entitlements from any fair price shop in the country using biometric/Aadhaar authentication.
objectives: Ensure nationwide portability of ration card benefits
Support migrant workers and their families
Enable seamless delivery of subsidised food grains across states

benefits.title: Nationwide Portability
benefits.description: Access to subsidised foodgrains from any fair price shop across India

otherCriteria: Existing NFSA ration card holders, particularly migrant workers

applicationProcess.description: Visit any fair price shop across India
Authenticate via biometric/ePoS device to claim entitlement

faqs.question: Is ONORC available across all states?
faqs.answer: Yes, it has been implemented across all states and UTs.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar linking mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aadhaar seeding is required to avail portability benefits.

name: Annapurna Scheme
overview: A scheme providing free foodgrains to indigent senior citizens who are eligible for old age pension but not receiving it, ensuring food security in old age.
objectives: Provide food security to elderly persons not covered by pension
Support indigent senior citizens without family support
Ensure basic nutritional needs of eligible elderly

benefits.title: Free Foodgrains
benefits.description: 10 kg of foodgrains provided free of cost per month per beneficiary

otherCriteria: Eligible for old age pension but not currently receiving it, with no means of subsistence

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body
Verification of eligibility by local authorities

faqs.question: Who is eligible for Annapurna?
faqs.answer: Senior citizens eligible for old-age pension but not receiving it, with no other means of support.

faqs.question: How much foodgrain is given?
faqs.answer: 10 kg per beneficiary per month, free of cost.
